title: Session 1 — Participant 35: Motorized Rotary Escapement Feeder CAD Design with Claude
goal: Design and automate the 3D CAD modeling of a Motorized Rotary Escapement Feeder, including kinematic torque calculations, AI-assisted VBA macro generation, and GD&T manufacturing documentation.
context: I am designing a motorized rotary escapement feeder (a spinning "star-wheel" mechanism) that dispenses tennis balls one by one for an autonomous robot. I need to calculate the rotational physics (torque/inertia), automate the creation of the base 3D CAD model using a VBA script, refine the 3D geometry manually, and produce a 2D manufacturing blueprint with correct tolerances.

session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: I successfully calculated the torque requirements, modeled the 3D star-wheel, and drafted the 2D GD&T blueprint. However, the AI severely struggled with generating a functional SolidWorks VBA macro. After 30 minutes of continuous debugging and run-time errors with Claude's code, I had to rely on my own domain expertise to override the AI and execute a functioning script to keep the workflow moving.

Step 1.step_action: I will ask Claude/Gemini to calculate the rotational inertia and required motor holding torque for a 200mm aluminum rotary feeder disk running at 60 RPM. Based on the output, I will ask it to recommend between a NEMA 23 stepper motor and a BLDC gearmotor for this specific application.
